name: Montgomery County, OH
findings: Montgomery County has 2,033 nonprofit organizations. 901 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 737 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Montgomery County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Economic development organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 23 economic development organizations here list public events, compared with about 10 in similar places of this size.
